629357.Description: [On Play] If you have 2 or more Battle Cards with "Demon Clan" in their special traits in your Battle Area, choose up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less in your opponent's Battle Area and KO it.

[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.

[Permanent] If you have "Piccolo Jr. : Youth" in your Battle Area, reduce the cost of this card in your hand by 3.

[On Play] Place 1 "Piccolo Jr. : Youth" in your Battle Area into its owner's Drop.

629363.Description: [On Play/When Attacking] If you have 5 or more cards with "Demon Clan" in their special traits in your Drop, draw 1 card.

629365.Description:
[Field] (This card remains in your Battle Area until you place another [Field].)

[On Play] During this turn, the next time you use a non-[Field] Extra with an original cost of 2 or less, after activating the skill, activate that Extra's skill again.
